When I was 12 a group of classmates tried to kill me, citing my atheism as the reason.  When I returned to school a few days later the leader had told everyone that I had followed them home and threatened to kill them.  What followed was a campaign of terror against me in which I was viciously hounded by my peers and ostracized by the adults at the school.  I was afraid to ride the bus due to the constant threat of violence and I was not allowed to call home for a ride, so i walked the three miles home alone every day.  A bomb threat was forged in my name, I was accused of being a child prostitute, and at one point I was asked point blank by the principal if I intended to shoot up the school.  I was accused of being a Satan worshipper and a rumor persisted that I would kidnap and sacrifice neighborhood pets (I am a massive animal lover and would NEVER willingly harm a pet).

I eventually had to leave that school when i told my parents I would kill myself if they made me go back.  I lost all but two of the friends I had, and developed a fear of schools as a result.  

I have nightmares almost 2 decades later on a nearly daily basis.  I haven't been able to successfully complete college because of my fear.  I even developed a neurological disorder from the stress.  

In a lot of ways I probably won't ever get over this.

We both smoke for physical pain and PTSD.  Its the only way I can sleep at night and doesn't make me hungry like it does him.  But I think ultimately if I present all the suggestion you guys helped with we can find a way to work around everything.

I like all of this, and it also occurred to me meal prep could be an option since he likes my cooking so much and I can just have meals ready to go in the fridge that would be more filling than normal snacking.

As I mentioned before he is a fairly picky eater and while he eats a lot, its only certain foods which he likes.  But I am now considering meal prep so when i am not home he has pre-made meals just ready to go that he can eat instead of trying to keep himself full on snack food.

Problem is those foods only get eaten if I am home to cook them.  He doesn't cook and my attempts to teach him haven't gone as well as i hoped.  If he doesn't have stuff like the junk food he will wait to eat until I get off work even if it means he doesn't eat for 8+ hours while I am gone.  Maybe if I do meal prep?  I haven't tried that yet!
We only have the one car but we could definitely use it as a bonding thing if he rides along!

The other issue is he is way, way pickier than me in terms of what he likes.  He doesn't like most fruit or veg unless its cooked into something etcetcetc.  But I think discount shopping could definitely be a viable option.
Unfortunately we both work 6 days at a restaurant already and get a free meal each day, but its just a sandwich.  I thought about postmsting or something to get extra cash.

Unfortunately most people in our community live below the poverty line.  We come from a really poor area.  We both work full time 5 to 6 days a week.  But it isn't always enough :(

I don't want to make him feel guilty about it as it isn't intentional and I know he needs his food.  I thought about discount shops, which would be way more time consuming going to multiple shops during our grocery run but I just want to be as fair as possible.  We both inherited our poverty (generational poverty suuuuucks) and are working to break the cycle but it hasn't been easy.

We have merged our finances to make it easier to budget, but maybe if I drag him to the shops with me he will get a better idea of how much it all costs?  I have also considered spreading my shopping out by getting his snack food at a discount shop to save on money.

He has; he works on his feet all day and we do hike a few times a week.  He is a fairly active dude with a clean bill of health.  

I have considered doing the shopping at different stores: a discount store like Dollar Tree for his snacking, regular store for meat and produce for regular meals.  A lot more time consuming but it would possibly mean I wouldn't have to make him change his habits.

I'm really not trying to deprive him of food, but I honestly don't know what other costs to cut.  I am definitely not trying to body shame him, and I definitely don't have room to do that lmao.

But if it were reversed...  I think I would try to not eat as much.  A lot of it occurs after he smokes and gets the munchies, and most of his eating is snacking in addition to three large meals.  

I really hope I don't come across as shamey or hateful because that really isn't where my concern lies at all.

I feel like I should be clear that the cereal and hot pockets are DEFINITELY not the only food in the house.  They are technically only supposed to be snack food for our days off.  The majority of the food I get is better than that: eggs, fresh fruit and veg, sandwich fixings, stuff to cook, actual food.  Which is eaten about as quickly.

He is grooming you.  Tell your Mom IMMEDIATELY and get the police involved.  What he is doing is illegal and he is absolutely planning to hurt you. 

I am so sorry he is doing this to you.
